name: Houdini MCP: Atmosphere Builder
description: Generates a cinematic atmospheric depth plan from zone data, layout rules, atmosphere type, and scene theme. Returns recommended fog density, depth layers, particle layers, and atmospheric readability. Planning only — no bridge calls, no mutations.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.atmosphere_orchestrator import get_atmosphere_orchestrator


class HouMCPAtmosphereBuilderNode(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_atmosphere_builder"
    category = "Houdini"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.icon_path = "icons/houdini_icon.png"
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("zones_json",        "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("layout_rules_json",  "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("atmosphere_type",    "string", widget_type="text", default="cinematic_depth_fog")
        self.add_input("scene_theme",        "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("atmosphere_plan",    "any")
        self.add_output("recommended_density","float")
        self.add_output("atmosphere_type",    "string")
        self.add_output("readable",           "bool")
        self.add_output("depth_layers",       "list")
        self.add_output("particle_layers",    "list")
        self.add_output("plan_json",          "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    def _empty(self, error=""):
        return {
            "atmosphere_plan": {}, "recommended_density": 0.0, "atmosphere_type": "",
            "readable": False, "depth_layers": [], "particle_layers": [],
            "plan_json": json.dumps({"error": error}),
            "exec_out": True,
        }

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw_zones        = (inputs.get("zones_json") or "{}").strip() or "{}"
        raw_layout_rules = (inputs.get("layout_rules_json") or "{}").strip() or "{}"
        atmosphere_type  = (inputs.get("atmosphere_type") or "cinematic_depth_fog").strip()
        scene_theme      = (inputs.get("scene_theme") or "").strip()

        try:
            zones = json.loads(raw_zones) if isinstance(raw_zones, str) else raw_zones
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            self.log_error(f"zones_json is not valid JSON: {exc}")
            return self._empty(error=f"invalid zones_json: {exc}")

        try:
            layout_rules = json.loads(raw_layout_rules) if isinstance(raw_layout_rules, str) else raw_layout_rules
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            self.log_error(f"layout_rules_json is not valid JSON: {exc}")
            return self._empty(error=f"invalid layout_rules_json: {exc}")

        if not isinstance(zones, dict) or not isinstance(layout_rules, dict):
            self.log_error("zones_json and layout_rules_json must be JSON objects.")
            return self._empty(error="inputs must be JSON objects")

        orchestrator = get_atmosphere_orchestrator()
        try:
            depth_atm     = orchestrator.generate_depth_atmosphere(zones, layout_rules)
            resolved_type = depth_atm.get("atmosphere_type", atmosphere_type)
            density       = float(depth_atm.get("recommended_density", 0.03))
            zone_depths   = {z: float(i * 10) for i, z in enumerate(["background", "midground", "hero_area"]) if z in zones}
            fog_layers    = orchestrator.generate_fog_layers(resolved_type, density, zone_depths)
            vol_density   = orchestrator.generate_volumetric_density(resolved_type, None)
            particle_layers = orchestrator.build_particle_layers(scene_theme, resolved_type)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Atmosphere orchestration failed: {exc}")
            return self._empty(error=f"orchestration failed: {exc}")

        atmosphere_plan = {
            "atmosphere_type":    resolved_type,
            "recommended_density": density,
            "depth_atmosphere":   depth_atm,
            "fog_layers":         fog_layers,
            "volumetric_density": vol_density,
            "particle_layers":    particle_layers,
        }

        readability = orchestrator.evaluate_atmospheric_readability(atmosphere_plan)
        readable    = bool(readability.get("readable", False))

        self.log_info(f"Atmosphere plan: type={resolved_type}, density={density:.3f}, readable={readable}")

        return {
            "atmosphere_plan":     atmosphere_plan,
            "recommended_density": density,
            "atmosphere_type":     resolved_type,
            "readable":            readable,
            "depth_layers":        fog_layers,
            "particle_layers":     particle_layers,
            "plan_json":           json.dumps(atmosphere_plan, indent=2, default=str),
            "exec_out":            True,
        }


def register_node():
    return HouMCPAtmosphereBuilderNode
